Preemptive Cyber Defense with Indicators of Future Attack (IOFA)™

Silent Push provides preemptive cyber defense that reveals adversary infrastructure as it’s created, with IOFA™. Organizations quickly block attacks and defend against the known global threats and most importantly, proactively address what is lurking in the unknown. 

Book a Demo

Reveal The Full Threat Landscape

Our cyber early warning system reveals unique digital fingerprints of attacker behavior and intent, constructed using the Tactics, Techniques and Procedures (TTPs) that govern how a threat actor creates, deploys and manages their infrastructure over time, to evade detection. 

Silent Push is the only cybersecurity platform that offers Indicators of Future Attack (IOFA)™ – domains and IPs which are yet to be fully deployed in an attack, including assets initiated during the reconnaissance and weaponization phases. IOFA™ allow teams to track patterns in attacker DNS automation, that show where the next digital assault will originate from. 

Learn more about IOFA™

Expose Malicious Intent Early

Incident Response, Threat Intelligence and SOC teams can swiftly act to protect their organization with preemptive indicators of attacker behavior.

Proactive Threat Hunting

Preemptively identify, evaluate, monitor, and block domains and IPs used in attacks by analyzing the patterns threat actors use to deploy and manage their infrastructure.

Learn More

Brand Impersonation

Execute automated brand impersonation scans that protect your organization and supply chain against domain and email-based phishing and spoofing attacks. 

Learn More

Automated Feed Intelligence

Counteract global threat activity with an automated adversary intelligence system: including APT feeds, C2 infrastructure monitoring and TLP Amber/Red research.

Learn More

Level-up your SIEM and SOAR workflows

Utilize a range of native integrations that connect Silent Push data with industry-leading SIEM, SOAR and TIP platforms. Automate downstream actions that reduce manual intervention, and provide fast, reliable context on unknown indicators in your alert queues.

Robust threat data integrations

Use a Silent Push Enterprise subscription to feed enriched threat data into your existing security stack using a suite of 100+ domain, IPv4/6 and URL endpoints. Enrich your organization’s threat hunting and detection operations with risk and reputation scoring tailored to your unique requirements.

Silent Push Chrome Extension

Our integrated Chrome extension allows Enterprise Edition users with an API key to scan, extract, save and analyze DNS data in Silent Push direct from a web browser, including URLs, domains, and IPs. 

Instantly flag indicators in IOFA™ Feeds and receive risk scores

Extract DNS records and WHOIS data directly from any webpage

One-click pivot into the Silent Push platform for live and historical scans
